coding_method: Assistant review of complete 3,174-character rendered answer, six scoped DOM hrefs and existing activity capture. No external webpage visits, feature/pricing audit or independent human double-coding.
coding_scope: Substantively named tools/services/surfaces with supplied target platforms separate. Product recommendations, monitoring channels, coverage mentions and source-only citation labels retain distinct roles.

registrable_domain_mapping.method: Explicit manual normalization removes leading www from 01net.com, ranked.ai and amicited.com; exact observed DOM hrefs/hostnames remain preserved. No external public-suffix lookup used.

capture_scope.citation_mapping_scope: Six exact rendered-article hrefs; not all 75 retrieval hits.

notes: Activity shows grouped searches of four and two plus a separate displayed web query with 10 results, with browsed-link controls. Exact query coverage is partial.
Introductory 01net and later Amicited strings are rendered citation labels, not substantive recommendations to use or follow creators.
The 75-source badge is not a unique inline citation count.
Workspace-explored activity labels do not establish their underlying contents or influence.
Claimed free tiers, signup requirements, engine coverage, times, reliability and relative source influence remain platform output, not verified facts.
capture_scope.public_copy_note: Body length and source hash describe this redacted public record. Original citation position indexes are omitted; semantic judgments are retained.

coding_cautions: Run free snapshot tools once is an active instruction for all four named checkers; their recommendations are not inferred merely from source labels.
Four own-domain product links support C=true for Ranked, Snoika, Indexly and Mangools. Ahrefs is recommended without an own-content href.
01net is a supporting citation label adjacent to the introduction, not a substantive creator recommendation.
Google search, review/community monitoring, community contribution and measurement software are distinct roles.
Model/version/search-state logging is not required by the listed columns, despite advice to enable ChatGPT search.
A claimed checker distinction between knowing and recommending a brand is recorded; the manual log itself does not explicitly define a separate active-recommendation field/rate.
